approved_scope.title: Stop tests stall on a per-fixture token so concurrent runs never take or kill each other processes (144)
approved_scope.description: Stop tests stall on a per-fixture token so concurrent runs never take or kill each other processes (144)
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: Issue #144: stop tests matched their stalled child machine-wide by sleep 6xx; test isolation only, no requirement text changes.
acceptance_criteria: Every stop test stalls on a unique per-fixture token and matches and reaps only it, so a concurrent run of the same test (simulated by sleep 641/642/643 decoys) is neither taken for a survivor nor killed; every existing stop assertion holds; the decoy test fails first and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: Issue #144 (found by ch-pr69); orc: fix after #132; identity() from the #95 review; no weakening.
